notes:
New Features:

- Redlight HD localhost playback now explicitly supports Kodi HTTP HEAD/Stat probes before the manifest GET, keeping the stable local relay URL compatible with both IPTV and direct Site playback.
- Release Notes now use one document-wide scroll viewport in both the post-update window and Settings, so all sections and headings move together instead of scrolling independently.

Improvements:

- Removes the redundant automatic PVR reload on the first Site open; IPTV Simple keeps its already loaded playlist unless an explicit Adult IPTV update is requested.
- Release Notes no longer depend on ControlList item-height arguments or ControlTextBox scrolling; keyboard, mouse wheel and Yatse all drive the same manual viewport offset.
- Redlight relay refresh alarms are replaced cleanly when a new session is activated, and v1.118 moves the relay to a fresh localhost port so a still-running v1.117 helper cannot be reused after an in-place update.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes v1.117 relay health checks succeeding while Kodi CCurlFile::Stat timed out on the local redlight.m3u8 URL, which caused OpenDemuxStream failures and brief UI freezes.
- Fixes the v1.117 Settings crash caused by the unsupported ControlList itemHeight keyword on Kodi 22.
- Removes the post-update Container.Refresh/PVR first-open churn that could make the Site appear to restart internally immediately after an update.
